_brief: Tal 2026-10-03 (batch item 4, Frame.io FLOWERS FOR STRANGERS / OLD LADY JERUSALEM): "Keep this one very wholesome and simple. You can use a little bit of what she says, especially anything about how happy she is, but it doesn't need to be dialogue-heavy. I would rather see: her smiling - close-ups of her reaction - a few of her best words/lines - English captions if she's speaking Hebrew - emotional music underneath." No music file exists (and none is ripped): the cut holds on location sound; the track is still to be added. Captions from cache/translate/local-1f0b76943a391c55.json, RE-READ 2026-10-03 with two models (see its note). KEY FINDING: 'you made me so happy' in the earlier cut is the CAREGIVER saying 'you made HER so happy' - the old lady's lips are closed when it starts. Observer 8345 = POV - 2.03s, 8346 = POV - 35.13s (envelope xcorr, checked on the handover and the hand-hold).
beats: HOOK, wide: she is wheeled up to us and sees the sunflower held out at the bottom of frame. Starts after Tal's 'chag sameach' (run ends 6.10)
TIGHT: her mouth opens in surprise - 'THANK YOU!' (6.5-7.0, both models)
CUT to the observer iPhone: Tal, crouched in, puts the sunflower in her hands - the giving SEEN, Tal in frame. POV sound underneath (graft at 7.0667 = 8345 5.0333 + 2.03)
back to her face, flower in hand - 'HEALTH AND JOY!' (7.62-8.9, both models: livriut / u-vriut ve-simcha)
she looks up at her bouquet (strangers have added roses) - her 'wow' (20.2-20.6) uncaptioned, the face says it

the camera whips to her CAREGIVER, beaming: 'YOU MADE HER SO HAPPY!' (20.9-22.0) ... 'THAT'S HOW IT SHOULD BE.' (23.43-24.4). One beat from the whip on, so the first line is not lost as a straddle. Ends 24.4667, between 'tzarich' and 'rak'

the camera swings back to HER while the caregiver keeps talking - 'JUST GIVE JOY,' (24.54-25.82) - landing on her fingers at her lips, slow push in. One beat from the swing so the line is not lost as a straddle. [r2: own audio, no graft]

HER REACTION, tight: fingers at her lips, moved, looks down and back up - 'BE HEALTHY!' (26.3-26.97). Out at 27.3333: 0.36s after the word, before her own 'toda lachem' (27.35), so her lips never move under someone else's line. [r4->r5: out 27.0667, in the RMS trough (-45 dB at 27.03-27.08) right after be-healthy - check-boundary heard her toda start before 27.33, a soft onset at 27.13]

HER BEST LINE TO TAL: hand raised, she blesses him - 'STAY HEALTHY!' (tihye bari 47.4-48.95, both models) - and his hand reaches in. Starts after 'naim lehakir' (run ends 47.15); ends before the 'bye' run at 49.25
observer wide: Tal holds her hand, goodbye - 'BYE!' (49.25). POV sound (graft 49.2 = 8346 14.0667 + 35.13), ends 50.47 before the unresolved word at 50.52

SLOW-MO x0.5, LAST IMAGE: wheeled off down the market, she lifts her bouquet. Crop held left (x 0.25, 1.8x) to keep the man walking on the right out of frame. Proxy only. [r3: out 9.4 - in r3 the man in black still reached the right edge by 9.5]
_sound: bedOnly: the soundtrack is LOCATION-SOUND.wav in this folder - the SAME source windows the beats play (graft window, or real-time window under a slow-mo beat), extracted as continuous runs, denoised once per run (-a 10, 0.5s pre-roll), no per-beat gain. Built by the ek story-editor soundtrack.py (beat-by-beat denoise + level-matching put 20 dB steps and DeepFilterNet onset dips at 4-frame snap joins where the sound is really continuous: measured -64 dB holes at 4.57s/4.70s in r3). Rebuild it if any beat window changes. No music: Tal asked for emotional music on the old-lady cut; none exists in the repo and none is ripped. The track ends with a 0.35s fade: the observer phone hears market chatter right up to the last frame.
